bosses.name: Ben Hyuga, SeraphicRadiance
bosses.strategy:
'———————————————————'   preferably, a Thera Extract.

Fuse into Amon, or if you need some spare SP, then Lobo (since he has the
2nd highest P-Def at this point, as well as the same P-Atk as Amon). All
you'll be doing is physically attacking a round or two, then healing the
next. Yep, that's it... pretty boring actually, but any other route will
likely get you killed. Trust me, it's worth it.

If you find yourself in trouble, try using Third Keys to help dish out
damage when you have an opportunity to. If you're STILL having trouble
with him, then you'll just have to level up and try again.

  NOTE     You must have done the following to trigger this last series of
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   events:

           - Obtained the Erotic Book in Shanghai.
           - Defeated the Orb Chaos/Cherubim/Seraphim in the bonus dungeons.
           - Played the Lottery with EVERY member up until now.
           - Been sent to Neameeto at least once.
           - Obtained ALL 3 Fusions in each Fusion class, AND Amon for Yuri.

After completing the Atman events, talk to Roger in the Nemeton Monastery;
he'll notice the Erotic Book you have, and will give you the [_PULSE TRACT_] in
exchange for it!

Talk to Roger again, and he'll want help for an experiment. The help? The
dreaded Spin Ring _10_! Yes, _30_ hits on the Judgment Ring! Personally, I was
able to get it in two tries (the first time I missed the very last one), but
keep at it, and you'll eventually hit them all. Try your best not to break your
TV, your controller, your PS2, ANYTHING. Stay calm and focused, and you should
do it. By completing it, you'll receive Yuri's best weapon, the
[_NIGHTBIRD CLAW_].

Next, SAVE YOUR GAME! Then talk to Roger again, and he'll ask if you wish to go
to Neameeto.

———————————————————————————————————————————
   [1] Wait, I need to use the bathroom!
   [2] Let's go!
———————————————————————————————————————————

Choose 1, and as long as you have played the Lottery with ALL 15 of the
previous members, you'll find out that Roger is Lottery Member No. 00, the
Chairman!

           _________________________________________________________

Nothing strange about the ring here, just really small hit areas! Make sure to
win both the CottonUnderpants and Comet Mask before continuing on; the
CottonUnderpants is an accessory for Alice that increases her physical defense
AND cuts normal attack damage in half (and change the color of her panties from
pink to white!), while the Comet Mask increases P-Def, S-Def, and P-Avd when
equipped, and can't be obtained anywhere else. If you don't win what you want,
reload your last save and try again.

Now that we've met all the Lottery Members, feel free to waste your remaining
tickets on whichever Lottery Members you like! I recommend Seals of the Soul
for your lower SP party members, mainly Alice, as well as some of the other
Seals, and some of the ultimate recovery items like the TalismanOfPower, which
revives an ally completely when used.

If for some reason Roger doesn't show up as being the next Lottery Member, then
you missed someone. Here are the locations of all of the Lottery Members in the
game; you can't do anything about the ones in China, but you can check with all
of the ones here in Europe to make sure you didn't miss any:


   Asia
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Lottery Member No. #15: Fengtian (Building-loving Man)
Lottery Member No. #14: Dalian (Filthy Samo)
Lottery Member No. #13: Smuggler's Boat (Courier Subordinate)
Lottery Member No. #12: Shanghai, Huayuan (Sharp Van)
Lottery Member No. #11: Temple Ruins (Master Xiaofang)
Lottery Member No. #10: Kowloon Fortress (Invincible Nee)
Lottery Member No. #09: Shanghai, Kuihai Tower (Private Matsuura)


   Europe
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Lottery Member No. #08: Prague (Guard Homas)
Lottery Member No. #07: Bistritz (Hunter Warda)
Lottery Member No. #06: Rouen (Hooked-nose Robin)
Lottery Member No. #05: London, Old Castle Street (Drunken Orro)
Lottery Member No. #04: Calios Mental Hospital (Introverted Chopin)
Lottery Member No. #03: London, Orphanage (Pot-lover Macken)
Lottery Member No. #02: Rouen (Fake-nose Man) (if you already won his red
                        prize, he will no longer appear. You also must have
                        completed the Water Gravestone side quest and acted as
                        a preacher to have No. 02 appear to begin with.)
Lottery Member No. #01: Blue Castle (Keith-like invisible man)
Lottery Member No. #00: Roger Bacon (Nemeton Monastery)


Now that we're finished with the Lottery, we need to move on to the very last
side quest of them all: the Seraphic Radiance.

Examine the Pulse Tract that you received from Roger; it depicts a new path
through the Ancient Ruins, so that's where we're headed.


   Ancient Ruins
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Enter the maze, then take the following paths:

 - YELLOW    (left room)
 - RED       (left room)
 - GREEN     (center room)
 - VIOLET    (right room)
 - BLUE      (left room)
 - RED       (center room)
 - TURQUOISE (right room)

After you reach the very last area, be back at the beginning. Descend the
stairs here and walk up to the altar; you'll find a chest containing the
[_STONE OF REBIRTH_]. Make your way out of the Ancient Ruins and back onto the
World Map. SAVE YOUR GAME and enter the Graveyard for the last time.

   Graveyard
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
  NOTE     The next battle is EXTREMELY difficult, as it will be with Yuri
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   alone. I recommend doing the following things before attempting to
           fight:

           - Put Yuri in the back row.

           - Put both the Brsrkr Earrings and the Seven-Eyed Mask (or
             Comet Mask) on him to boost his HP and defense, respectively.

           - Equip the Mind's Eye on him, unless you're still taking more
             damage in two rounds that you can't heal on. If that's the case,
             equip a Voodoo Doll; it'll boost your S-Def a bit more AND revive
             Yuri once if he dies.

           - Stock up on Thera Extracts (Silent Peddler).

           - Buy some Third Keys to help speed the battle along. (optional)

Go through the northern gate, then go as far as you can north to examine the
sunset. Attempt to leave, and you'll encounter Ben Hyuga. After some discussion
about him and the Seraphic Radiance, you'll have to face him in an attempt to
conquer and capture the god.

Once he's defeated, you'll earn Yuri's final fusion, the [_SERAPHICRADIANCE_].
Watch the cut-scene here, and when you regain control, return to the  tree
where you fought Ben. Open a chest behind the tree, and you'll find Yuri's best
armor, his [_FATHER'S COAT_].





=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=

That's it for all the side quests. Let's go to Neameeto and end this.
